pathology_name: Epithelial Ovarian Carcinoma (High-Grade Serous Carcinoma / Mucinous / Clear Cell / Endometrioid)
epidemiology: Leading cause of gynecologic cancer death. 75% of patients present at advanced stage (FIGO Stage III/IV). Peak incidence in postmenopausal women (55-75 years).
pathophysiology: Heterogeneous group comprising High-Grade Serous (HGSC - originating mostly from distal fimbrial epithelium of fallopian tube), Low-Grade Serous, Clear Cell, Endometrioid, and Mucinous carcinomas.

classic_malignant_ultrasound_features.feature_1: Multilocular-Solid or Completely Solid mass with irregular external contours and inhomogeneous parenchymal texture.
classic_malignant_ultrasound_features.feature_2: Multiple (≥ 4) vascularized papillary projections arising from cyst wall and thick irregular septa (thickness ≥ 3 mm).
classic_malignant_ultrasound_features.feature_3: High vascularity on Color/Power Doppler (Color Score 3-4) with low-resistance neo-vascular flow (Resistive Index RI < 0.40, Pulsatility Index PI < 0.80).
classic_malignant_ultrasound_features.feature_4: Ascites (fluid in pouch of Douglas and upper abdominal perihepatic/perisplenic spaces).
classic_malignant_ultrasound_features.feature_5: Peritoneal carcinomatosis: hypoechoic nodular implants on omentum ('omental cake') or parietal peritoneum.

iota_simple_rules_alignment: Meets multiple M-rules: M1 (Irregular solid tumor), M2 (Ascites), M3 (≥ 4 papillary projections), M4 (Irregular multilocular-solid ≥ 100 mm), M5 (Color Score 4).
iota_adnex_alignment: High predicted probability for Stage II-IV invasive ovarian carcinoma (typically > 60-80%).
clinical_management: Urgent referral to Gynecologic Oncology. Staging CT Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis, serum CA-125 + HE4, and primary debulking cytoreductive surgery followed by platinum-taxane chemotherapy +/- PARP inhibitors.
